subject.title: feat(kimi): show code quota in usage status

question: Should OpenClaw ship managed Kimi Coding quota polling as bundled provider-status behavior for existing Kimi credentials?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded and avoids new credential precedence, but enabling a provider-specific managed usage endpoint establishes an ongoing bundled provider and auth-support commitment that source review cannot choose unilaterally.

options.title: Accept managed Kimi usage status
options.body: Land this focused provider-owned hook, retaining official-endpoint-only polling and the existing credential sources.

options.title: Keep Kimi status outside bundled scope
options.body: Close or redirect the proposal if Kimi quota reporting should remain an external integration rather than a bundled provider capability.

recommendation.title: Accept managed Kimi usage status
recommendation.body: Land this focused provider-owned hook, retaining official-endpoint-only polling and the existing credential sources.

likelyOwner.reason: The implementation author can clarify the narrowed endpoint and credential contract, while a repository owner must make the product decision.
